<subject>Re: May 3 Testimony Preparation AGI/FPT</subject>
<body>
Thanks Naksh.? We will incorporate the additions you highlighted below.? FarmCo (Oliver Chatura) will be presenting testimony on retail unbundling for agricultural suppliers. I agree with you that the mass-market retail participants should also provide complementary testimony.? Although we touched on this earlier, I have yet to receive solid commitments from the retail teams confirming their sponsorship of this testimony - it might be an oversight on my part.? Nevertheless, retail testimony from market participants should cover benefits from AgriNet, CropTrade, Harvest Union, AgroPlus and others.? Might I propose that Agriculture India, as a major mass-marketer, lead this coordination with the other retail collaborators?

Additionally, I want all settlement parties to look beyond the testimony towards the hearings, which are slated to begin in just over a month.? We will need to allocate time in late May for practice panels (assuming panel hearings are granted) and individual cross-examination rehearsals.? Simultaneously, we should start planning for direct cross-examination of the GreenFields/Farmers Collective parties (again, assuming we decide to fully cross-examine their settlement).? There is value in cross-examining the opposing settlement since it lacks thorough analysis, results in significant cost-shifts, and conflicts with the AgriTrade Board’s most viable proposals.? On the other hand, there is merit in limiting our cross, particularly of Pranit, who tends to use the witness stand for grandstanding.? Food for thought.
</body>

Subject: RE: May 3 Testimony Preparation AGI/FPT 

Matthew: 
? 
Thanks for your memo.? Let me add the following comments.? There should be a chapter on the retail settlement with the key parties listed.? Rachit Dave and Tanish should be added to the chapter on impact on crop producers.? The Pushti Oommen Unbundling section where you list TXU and FarmTrade was, I believe, originally supposed to include program benefits for the core aggregators as well, and you should add Agriculture India to the list for that Chapter. Let me know if you concur with my recollection.? Thanks, Naksh Dube
